text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Light Hello once watched as the role model she adored failed to ever reach center stage at a winning concert, despite countless hours of training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Those bitter memories fuel Hello's present work. As we're handing out flyers one day, I spot a student glaring at us with anger in her eyes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, Silence Suzuka is agonizing over something Agnes Tachyon said. What do concerts mean to her, and what does that have to do with her running?
